title: cenchrus americanus
intro: Cenchrus americanus, commonly known as Pennisetum glaucum or Pearl Millet, is an annual plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is a rich source of nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, Cenchrus americanus has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and mucolytic properties.
